audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable for 2 seconds on a 28/25/22/19/16 cooldown, which means a taunt or combo spent into it is refunded to him entirely. Also unstated: Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so standing behind your minions denies his poke.
audit.why: Kit text — W: 'becoming untargetable for 2 seconds'; E: 'can be blocked by enemy units'. Galio W is 18s at rank 1, so trading it for a 2s pool is a losing exchange.
audit.corrected: Trading rules, cooldowns and mid-game text now say to wait the 2 seconds out and taunt him on surfacing, and to poke from behind the minion line.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d called Sanguine Pool a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16 — fifteen seconds is shorter than it ever gets.
audit.corrected: 28s at rank 1 stated in both fields; Tides of Blood 13s and Shield of Durand 18s added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal timing was mentioned only in passing in the itemization report entry and nowhere in the spike text.
audit.why: Transfusion has no cost and reaches 4.6s cooldown at rank 5; Hemoplague heals per champion hit. Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names the first-back anti-heal buy as the real first-item decision.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-engage: taunt their dive, shield their magic, and R the teammate they thought was alone.
edits.after: Late Vladimir out-duels you 1v1: Crimson Pact turns his health into AP and Sanguine Pool dodges the taunt — group, never isolate.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. It governs your forward steps. - W Shield of Durand spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 2 seconds untargetable — bait it, then commit inside that window. - Tides of Blood is 13s at rank 1 and enemy units block it. - Your W Shield of Durand is 18s at rank 1: save it for his surface.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Q the contact, tornado ticking, E-auto when he steps in, W-taunt on the Transfusion — one rotation faster than his 28s pool can answer.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Dumping the whole combo into a 2-second Sanguine Pool — he surfaces untouched and healed, and your taunt is gone for 18 seconds.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield. Bad trade: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the contact, tornado ticking, E-auto when he steps in, W-taunt on the Transfusion — one rotation faster than his 28s pool can answer. Bad trade: dumping the whole combo into a 2-second Sanguine Pool — he surfaces untouched and healed, and your taunt is gone for 18 seconds.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Colossal Smash and Q chip him free — Tides of Blood is blocked by the minions you stand behind.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Taunt as he walks in for Transfusion range; taunting a Vladimir already leaving just buys him a free Sanguine Pool exit.

edits.before: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Vladimir burns Sanguine Pool on nothing — that is 28 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 — spend it on the wave and you cannot reach him when Sanguine Pool is finally down.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling out of your taunt, healing the trade back with Transfusion, and out-scaling you into a late 1v1.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by arriving — Sanguine Pool lasts only 2 seconds, so land the R, wait it out, and taunt him as he surfaces.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared middle wave that keeps your R timer flexible — Galio waves are about being free to leave. Worst wave: a hard-shoved wave when your bot lane is fighting — the R you couldn't channel is the fight your team lost. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a middle wave you can leave — Tides of Blood clears fast at 13s rank 1, so match his clear and keep the R timer free. Worst wave: a wave you shove flat while he stands at 600 range healing every Transfusion off it. Crash timing: crash before you roam — he has no way to punish the walk, and your R covers whatever he answers with.

edits.before: A completed Liandry's or Rylai's spikes Vladimir's sustain and burst hard through his passive healing, making his 1v1 durability the real threat starting here.
edits.after: His first item turns Transfusion into real sustain, so buy Grievous Wounds right after it — anti-heal timing, not damage, decides your extended trades from here.

edits.before: Hemoplague coming online at 6 raises his damage ceiling in fights, but he still has to get in range to use it, and your stun-heavy kit punishes any commitment he makes. Keep forcing trades whenever Pool is down, and don't let him free-scale — his power curve only improves from here, so early aggression matters.
edits.after: Hemoplague at 6 raises his damage ceiling, but its 625 range still drags him toward you, and Sanguine Pool only buys 2 untargetable seconds — hold the taunt until he surfaces rather than spending it into the pool. Keep forcing trades whenever Pool is down, and don't let him free-scale; his curve only improves from here.
